title: P(doom)
summary: Armin Ronacher explores the concept of P(doom) - the probability of catastrophic AI outcomes - examining how we estimate and reason about existential risk from advanced AI systems, likely with his characteristic technical and skeptical analysis.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of reasoning about low-probability, high-impact events like AI existential risk in a rational, quantifiable way.
why_valuable: Provides a developer's perspective on AI safety discourse, bridging the gap between technical implementation and long-term risk estimation.
